text.aria-label: Title text 'Known-answer test: the 90% interval holds the injected step in 80-98% of draws at every substation, for the four gated shapes'
text.tspan: Known-answer test: the 90% interval holds the injected step in 80-98%
of draws at every substation, for the four gated shapes

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'We added a known step to the real nights 200 times per substation and counted how often the interval held it. Each dot is one of the 14 substations. Green band: the per-substation target of 80 to 98%. Black line: 90%. Shapes: matched (grows with cold), ramp then plateau, flat (no cold dependence), and no step. The bottom two rows are descriptive and have no target.'
